name: Lancaster University
summary: A collegiate campus university in north-west England where each student joins a college; IB offers run from about 30 to 36 points.

ib.text: Offers run from 30 points with 15 from three HL subjects to 36 with 16, e.g. 32 with 16 at HL for International Relations; a required subject usually needs HL 6. IB English at SL or HL 5 proves your English.

programmes.name: Medicine and Surgery
programmes.about: Learn the body's systems together, meet simulated patients in year 1, then train on placements across Lancashire, Cumbria and Yorkshire with more than 70 healthcare providers, with a chance to intercalate between years 4 and 5.
programmes.ib: 36 points with at least 6 in three HL subjects, including any two of Biology, Chemistry and Psychology.

needs.note: Any two of Biology, Chemistry and Psychology at HL

programmes.selectionNote: UCAT is required; nobody is offered a place without an in-person multiple mini interview. GCSEs are scored too: 13 points from 8 subjects.

flagshipSource.title: Medicine and Surgery MBChB: placements with more than 70 healthcare providers across three regions (course page)

programmes.name: Environmental Science
programmes.about: Weather, climate, hydrology and flood risk in year 1, biogeochemistry, ecology and soil science in year 2, and a dissertation in year 3 by fieldwork, lab work or modelling, with field trips in the Lake District and Yorkshire Dales.
programmes.ib: 30 points with 15 from the best three HL subjects, including one HL science at grade 6.

needs.note: One HL science from the A-level list, incl. Biology, Chemistry, Geography, Maths, Physics or Psychology

programmes.selectionNote: Offers follow the IB points and HL grades; GCSE Maths and English at grade 4 are also needed.

flagshipSource.title: Environmental Science: taught in the Lancaster Environment Centre, accredited by the CEDHE (course page)

programmes.name: Linguistics
programmes.about: How language works and is used: phonetics, phonology, grammar and pragmatics, and language in politics, health, business and law, with access to phonetics, eye-tracking, perception and EEG labs.
programmes.ib: 35 points with 16 from the best three HL subjects. No particular subject is named.
programmes.selectionNote: Offers follow the IB points and HL grades.

flagshipSource.title: Linguistics: phonetics, eye-tracking, perception and learning, and EEG labs (course page)

notes: The international fee for International Relations is £26,300 a year in 2027/28.
Every student belongs to a college and pays a £40 college membership fee.
Lancaster makes offers in IB points and HL grades, not UCAS Tariff points.

faculties.name: Faculty of Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences
faculties.line: Most programmes include Discovery modules with other subjects; Linguistics asks 35 points with 16 at HL.

faculties.name: Lancaster University Management School
faculties.line: Degrees in management, marketing, economics and finance, many accredited by industry bodies.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science and Technology
faculties.line: Ten subject areas in seven departments; Environmental Science asks 30 points with 15 at HL and an HL science at 6.

faculties.name: Faculty of Health and Medicine
faculties.line: Medicine and Surgery needs UCAT and an interview, 36 points with 6,6,6 at HL, and closes on 15 October.
